lines.t: Look upon the stars, the vast unknown,
Heavens wide, ancient light has shown.
YAH spoke the world into the night,
Life ignites, exploding bright.
Life’s a blanket, spread and wide,
Multiplying, nowhere to hide.
Every corner, earth alive,
Creation’s pulse will drive, drive, drive!
From dust to breath, the cosmos sings,
Each moment born on sacred wings.
The voice that made the night and day,
Carries life in endless sway.
Life’s a blanket, spread and wide,
Multiplying, nowhere to hide.
Every corner, earth alive,
Creation’s pulse will drive, drive, drive!
Sprawl across the skies and seas,
Life’s a dance in mysteries.
YAH’s word the cosmic key,
Unlock the vast infinity.
Life’s a blanket, spread and wide,
Multiplying, nowhere to hide.
Every corner, earth alive,
Creation’s pulse will drive, drive, drive!
Look upon the stars, the whole unknown,
YAH causing all to be, the life we own.
